html:
G'oya

Oylar hisobotiga o'xshaydi, faqat qatorning chegaralari oldindan ma'lum emas: u birinchi savdo kunidan (MIN(day)) boshlanib, oxirgisida (MAX(day)) tugaydi. Kunlar qatorini yasab, savdolarni LEFT JOIN bilan ulaymiz va kun bo'yicha yig'amiz.

Yechim

WITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (
  SELECT MIN(day) FROM sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d + 1 FROM days WHERE d < (SELECT MAX(day) FROM sales)
)
SELECT d AS day, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total
FROM days
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.day = d
WHERE d IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d

Namunada savdolar 3-, 4-, 7- va 8-kunlarda. Natijada 3 dan 8 gacha olti kun, 5- va 6-kunlarda 0.

WHERE d IS NOT NULL bo'sh jadval uchun yozilgan. MIN savdo bo'lmasa ham bitta qator qaytaradi, faqat qiymati NULL. Shu NULL kunlar qatoriga tushadi.

Tuzoqlar

Bo'sh jadvalni unutish. Quyidagi so'rov boshqa testlardan o'tadi, lekin savdo bo'lmaganda NULL | 0 qatorini qaytaradi:

Noto'g'riWITH RECURSIVE days(d) AS (
  SELECT MIN(day) FROM sales
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d + 1 FROM days WHERE d < (SELECT MAX(day) FROM sales)
)
SELECT d AS day, COALESCE(SUM(s.amount), 0) AS total
FROM days
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.day = d
GROUP BY d

Qatorni SELECT 1 dan boshlash ham xato. Namunada 1- va 2-kun 0 bilan chiqib qoladi, holbuki ular birinchi savdodan oldin.

Boshqa yo'l

Chegaralarni alohida CTE'da bir marta hisoblash mumkin. Bo'sh jadvalda lo NULL, WHERE lo IS NOT NULL qatorni boshidayoq to'xtatadi. Savdolar ham oldindan kun bo'yicha yig'ilgan, shuning uchun COALESCE faqat LEFT JOIN topa olmagan kunlarga ishlaydi:

WITH RECURSIVE b AS (
  SELECT MIN(day) AS lo, MAX(day) AS hi FROM sales
),
days(d) AS (
  SELECT lo FROM b WHERE lo IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d + 1 FROM days, b WHERE d < hi
),
t AS (
  SELECT day, SUM(amount) AS s FROM sales GROUP BY day
)
SELECT d AS day, COALESCE(t.s, 0) AS total
FROM days
LEFT JOIN t ON t.day = d
